content: Immutable snapshots for Azure Disk Storage are now available in public preview. You can now apply an immutability policy to snapshots of any Azure disk type to prevent deletion for up to 90 days. While the policy is active, no one can delete the snapshot, regardless of role or permissions. This helps protect backups from ransomware, meet regulatory requirements for short-term backups that need fast restore, and guard against rogue AI agent behavior. Immutable snapshots complement Azure Backup immutable vaults. Use vaults for cost-efficient long-term retention, and immutable snapshots for short-term backups that need faster restore. Choose between two types of immutability policies: Unlocked policies let authorized users test a policy before locking it. Authorized users can extend, shorten, or remove an unlocked policy. Locked policies provide compliance-grade protection. They can only be extended. No one, including administrators and Azure, can shorten or remove them, so the snapshot can't be deleted until the retention period ends. There's no additional charge for immutability policies; protected snapshots continue to be billed at standard managed disk snapshot rates until you delete them. Learn more: Pricing page Documentation
